3.10 Sample Code and Model
In Listing 3.7 a blueprint for the components used in the Sensor/Actuator pattern is provided. The blueprint code is not complete but just gives an idea how it is realized. The composition component is not shown. Please note that the AUTOSAR meta model requests that a sensor actuator component type references a corresponding sensor or actuator, resp., using a HwDescriptionEntity, [11]. In this case a HwElement is needed to be used.
